new_series.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
new_series.synopsis: Four famous faces paired with a friend or a loved one must tackle the most formidable race yet - traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo to the southern tip of Australia.

new_series.title: Blue Planet III
new_series.synopsis: In the tropical seas, year-round sunshine has created the perfect conditions for the ocean’s richest habitats to flourish, but survival takes remarkable and surprising ingenuity.

new_series.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
new_series.synopsis: Professor Hannah Fry explores the promises and threats of AI, considering the ways in which superintelligent machines can help humanity as well as the ways in which they can be a hindrance.

new_series.title: The Traitors Ireland
new_series.synopsis: Siobhán McSweeney welcomes a group of strangers to Slane Castle to play the ultimate murder mystery game. Siobhán picks her Traitors, but this time, there’s a twist that causes immediate confusion.

new_series.title: Stand-Up Specials
new_series.synopsis: International comedy sensation Randy Feltface in his brand-new series about humans - from the perspective of a non-human.

new_series.title: Politically
new_series.synopsis: David Runciman explores the intertwined events of 1956: the Suez Crisis, the Hungarian revolution the American presidential election.

new_series.title: A Charles Paris Mystery
new_series.synopsis: Charles lands a role as a butler in reality show Murder in the Park, and it’s not long before one of the guests ends up dead.

new_series.title: Arc
new_series.synopsis: Noughties popstar Lucy Green is making her big comeback, but will her problems with addiction threaten it all? Sober companion Tim is hired to get her to rehab… in Arizona.

new_series.title: Limelight
new_series.synopsis: Ten years married and overlooked, Josie has fallen for a charming aid worker she has never met. One private video later, he wants ten grand. Comedy thriller stars Jessica Gunning.

new_series.title: Inheritance
new_series.synopsis: Gianni Agnelli's death sets off an earthquake that will shake his family to the core, and threaten the foundations of the Fiat business.
